title: Recording, mixing: Goodnight Tonight by Wings | 1978
content:
Studio Two, Abbey Road Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney

Wings began recording their standalone single ‘Goodnight Tonight’ on 6 February 1978.

The band was without a drummer and second guitarist, and this was a solo Paul McCartney session. He filled two tape reels with versions of the song during this session.

McCartney began the recordings by laying down a drum machine track. The longest take, lasting 7:18, was judged to have the best beats, and he overdubbed acoustic drums and a wash of chords on a keyboard, following by bass guitar.

The recording also had acoustic guitar, hi-hat, two electric guitar parts, and guide vocals during the first verse and chorus.

McCartney made a number of rough mixes towards the end of the session, filling two more tape reels.
